originalTitle: SIF AUM jumps 29% to Rs 17,858 crore in June; inflows surge 171% MoM
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in simple terms: Specialised Investment Funds (SIFs) had a big increase in the amount of money they managed, going up 29% to Rs 17,858 crore in June. This means more people are putting their money into these funds. The amount of new money coming into these funds also increased by a lot - 171% - from the previous month. This is a good sign for the mutual fund industry as a whole, which also saw a lot of investor interest in June. It's also notable that regular investments, known as SIPs, reached a record high, showing that individual investors are continuing to put money into the market.

originalTitle: DMart Q1 results: Cons PAT up 11% to Rs 860 crore, revenue rises to Rs 18,795 crore
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified explanation of the news: Avenue Supermarts, the company that owns DMart stores, has just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The company made a profit of Rs 860 crore, which is 11% more than it made during the same time last year. Its total sales, or revenue, also increased by 14.9% to Rs 18,795 crore. This shows that the company is performing well and making more money than it did last year. This is important because it can affect the company's stock price and influence investors' decisions to buy or sell its shares.

originalTitle: Nearly 60% of foreign inflows into India-focused funds withdrawn since 2024 peak: Report
simplifiedContent: Foreign investors have taken out almost 60% of the money they had put into funds that focus on Indian companies since the peak in 2024. This means they are no longer investing as much in India as they used to. The reason for this change is that they are now more interested in investing in artificial intelligence opportunities around the world. In 2026, $9 billion was withdrawn from India-focused funds, showing a significant shift in investment priorities. This matters because it can impact the performance of the Indian stock market and the companies listed on it.

originalTitle: Nomura sees 22% upside in Ather Energy. Here's why it's the brokerage's top EV pick
simplifiedContent: Nomura, a company that helps people decide what stocks to buy, thinks Ather Energy is a good investment. They believe the company's stock price will go up by 22% because it has a lot of potential for growth. Ather Energy makes electric two-wheelers, and Nomura thinks many people will start buying these instead of traditional gasoline-powered vehicles. This is why Nomura is recommending that people buy Ather Energy stock, and they've set a target price of ₹1,470. Nomura thinks Ather Energy is one of the best companies in the electric vehicle market, which is why they're suggesting it as a top investment.

originalTitle: Why large cap and mid cap funds could be the best mutual fund to bet on now, according to Abakkus study
simplifiedContent: A recent study by Abakkus Mutual Fund found that large cap and mid cap funds are a good investment option right now. This is because company earnings are improving and the prices of these funds are reasonable. The market has recently gone down, which means it's a good time for long-term investors to buy in. This could lead to stock prices increasing as company earnings grow, making it a potential good time to invest. The study suggests that now may be a good entry point for investors looking to put their money into large and mid cap funds.

originalTitle: AI chip fever returns? SK Hynix  share price surges 13% after blockbuster $26.5 billion US listing
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: SK Hynix, a company that makes computer chips, just started selling its shares on a big US stock market called Nasdaq, and it was very successful. The company raised $26.5 billion, which is a lot of money, and its share price went up 13%. This means investors are excited about the company and want to buy its shares. The reason for this excitement is that SK Hynix makes a type of chip that's important for artificial intelligence, and many investors think this technology will be in high demand. This surge in interest is notable because other similar companies have been experiencing ups and downs in the market lately.
